subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should the repository accept these six new immutable GitHub Action revisions after an owner verifies their upstream release provenance and refreshed credentialed workflow behavior?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code executed in security and publishing jobs, including credential-bearing registry logins; the remaining judgment is whether the reviewed upstream revisions are trusted for those privileged paths.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Confirm each SHA-to-release mapping, rebase onto current main, and merge if the refreshed workflow checks succeed.

options.title: Hold the update
options.body: Keep the current pins until the workflow owner can complete release-provenance and credential-path validation.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm each SHA-to-release mapping, rebase onto current main, and merge if the refreshed workflow checks succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent public release-workflow activity makes this the strongest available owner signal for container publishing and its credentialed action steps.
